pages.text: Void Bottles are items that can be used in Mariculture Machines to drain their tanks. They can also be placed in the world, where they will act like a void tank.
pages.title: Void Bottle

pages.text: The titanium bucket is simply a bucket. Except it can store up to 16000mB of liquid. It works the same way as a ladle, with the benefit of also being able to place blocks in the world.
pages.title: Titanium Bucket
